dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular jagged perimeters of high-intensity white pixels forming closed 'O' and semi-closed 'C' structures; most prominent 'O' ring located in the upper-mid dorsal region showing a sharp light-to-dark gradient from the edge to the interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density; isolated small clusters of solid high-intensity white pixels are dispersed across the anterior-lateral region and along the lower ventral-lateral margin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the primary mid-dorsal 'O' ring and two adjacent 'C' structures form an obtuse triangular relationship; a series of smaller high-intensity blobs are arranged in a roughly linear trajectory toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex interconnected network of annuli creating a chain-link texture topology along the central lateral axis.
